$comment: Reviewed route-table values that the OpenAPI document does not carry (OADR-0016 points 2 and 6, ota/sdk/README.md §5.3, task SDK-002). scripts/generate-operations.mjs applies them to src/internal/operations.js. Keys are x-sdk-method names. timeoutMs replaces the client's default timeout (30 s) for the operation; retry can only be made stricter ("never"). Every entry needs a reason. An entry for an operation that is not in the document yet names the specTask that adds it, and applies by itself once that task regenerates the table.

flights.search.reason: Amadeus Flight Offers Search plus storing every offer with its selling price; long searches take tens of seconds.

flights.upsell.reason: Amadeus Branded Fares Upsell plus storing the new offers.

flights.price.reason: Amadeus Flight Offers Price with the requested extras.

checkout.complete.reason: Amadeus order creation plus issuance in one call; retried only with the same Idempotency-Key.

checkout.completeWithAirlineCard.reason: Amadeus order creation plus issuance; the card is in the body, so the call is never retried (OADR-0017).

console.bookings.issue.reason: Amadeus ticket issuance of a staff action.

console.bookings.cancel.reason: Amadeus order cancellation plus the refund of a staff action.

console.bookings.import.reason: Amadeus order retrieval plus storing the imported booking.

console.bookings.retrieve.reason: Live Amadeus order retrieval, optionally with fare rules.
